==About me==

I've been a fan of the Wheel of Time since I was about 15.&nbsp; I am now 27 years old.&nbsp; The first thing I ever looked up on the Internet was the Wheel of Time.&nbsp; I have followed various forums and discussion boards over the years, but I&nbsp;am now mostly on the Dragonmount.com forums as jemron.

I have wanted for a long time to have a comprehensive encyclopedia of the Wheel of Time, and while I believe there are already great resources on the Internet for this purpose, to me, Wikipedia is the best place to get it all organized and correct in one place.

My goal is to improve currently existing articles as I have time by (1) Removing opinions or theory-based statements, (2) Including direct references from the books for each fact that is stated in each article that I edit, so that the information will be accurate and verifiable, (3) Making articles sound more grammatically correct, including fixing places where words should be italicized or capitalized as they are in the books (eg. ''Tel'aran'rhiod''), and (4) Hopefully fulfilling my desire to contribute in some small way to the fans of what I consider to be one of the greatest stories ever told.
